# RGBTDronePerson tiny evaluator provenance

`dyfclt/vendor/tiny_cocoeval.py` is adapted from the official QFDet/RGBTDronePerson evaluator at [NNNNerd/mmdet-rgbtdroneperson](https://github.com/NNNNerd/mmdet-rgbtdroneperson/blob/main/mmdet/datasets/evaluation/coco/cocoeval.py). It was copied from the locally available COXNet-release counterpart on 2026-09-30. The copied evaluator modifies the [COCO API `cocoeval.py`](https://github.com/cocodataset/cocoapi/blob/master/PythonAPI/pycocotools/cocoeval.py), whose header credits Piotr Dollar and Tsung-Yi Lin and identifies the [Simplified BSD license](https://github.com/cocodataset/cocoapi/blob/master/license.txt). The QFDet repository carries the [Apache 2.0 license](https://github.com/NNNNerd/mmdet-rgbtdroneperson/blob/main/LICENSE). Local copies of both licenses are retained as `COCO-BSD-LICENSE.txt` and `QFDet-APACHE-LICENSE.txt`.

The local adaptation adds a provenance module header and changes the evaluation standard lookup to use the `Params` instance, avoiding shared class-level configuration changes. `dyfclt/evaluation.py` supplies the benchmark's three detection categories, three IoU thresholds, 1,000 maximum detections, and tiny-object scale metrics. The [official dataset caller](https://github.com/NNNNerd/mmdet-rgbtdroneperson/blob/main/mmdet/datasets/droneperson.py) overrides the evaluator's standalone default of 200 with `proposal_nums=(100, 300, 1000)`. The separate `uncertain` category is excluded from the scored classes; an `uncertain` attribute on an annotation within a scored category is treated as an ignore flag. Excluded-category boxes are not remapped into person ignore regions. Source annotation files are loaded afresh and never edited.
